links.targetTitle: Keel's allocation positions are addressed chain-then-protoco

title: Keel is scoped to a single non-Ethereum ecosystem first, making it a chain-expansion bridgehead rather than a generic growth Agent
content:
A.6.1.1.3.1 does not give Keel an open remit over adoption; it gives it "an initial focus on the Solana ecosystem." Keel's operational identity is nevertheless anchored on Ethereum: A.6.1.1.3.2.1.1.3.1.1.2 places its SubProxy Account on Ethereum Mainnet.

The combination is the interesting part. Governance, accounting and Sky-side authority stay on Ethereum, while the growth target is a chain where Sky's stablecoin has no incumbent position and competes against locally native dollars. Keel is therefore structured as a bridgehead: an Ethereum-governed entity whose job is to establish USDS liquidity and Savings Rate access somewhere Sky's governance stack does not natively reach.

The trade-off is deliberate. A single-chain focus lets one Agent accumulate specific partnerships and venue knowledge instead of spreading incentives thinly across every chain, but it also concentrates Keel's outcome on the fortunes of one external ecosystem. The word "initial" is the release valve — the mandate is written to survive a change of target chain without a change of Agent.
description: The initial Solana focus narrows an otherwise open adoption mandate to one target chain, trading breadth for the depth needed to establish USDS liquidity where Sky has no incumbency.
